section.sectionSummaryBrief: Through this, we merit the true and complete redemption, when there will be a revelation of G‑dliness from below, and the bringing of oil and lighting of the menorah will be physical in the Third Beis HaMikdash.
section.t: And through this we merit, in the very near future, the true and complete redemption,
when there will be a revelation of G‑dliness also from the aspect of below.
And then there will be the bringing of the oil and the lighting of the lamps
(“And you shall take for yourself pure olive oil, to cause the lamp to ascend continually”)
in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,
